descriptions.zh:
§H星系地图§!可以提供对群星的大局观。可以用它来导航、扩张、指挥舰队以及标注边境。

打开§S星系地图§!；

£dot_green£在屏幕下方点击§H星系§!图标或按§HM§!键


                        £galaxy_view£
descriptions.en:
The §HGalaxy Map§! offers a strategic view of the stars. Use it to navigate, expand, command fleets, and monitor borders.

To open the §SGalaxy Map§!;

£dot_green£ Click the §HGalaxy§! icon at the bottom of the screen or press §HM§!


                        £galaxy_view£

tooltips.zh: §S教程：星系地图切换§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Galaxy Map Toggle§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
非常好！

对外£system£§S恒星系§!的第一次调查圆满完成了。

我们母星上区区一代人之前的天文学家们梦寐以求的行星数据现在已尽在掌握。

继续调查；

£dot_green£选择一艘£science_ship£§S科研船§!
£dot_green£右键点击邻近§S恒星系§!
£dot_green£选择§S调查恒星系§!

§S恒星系§!必须完成调查后才能宣称拥有。
descriptions.en:
Well done!

The first survey of a £system£ §SStar System§! beyond our own has been completed.

We now have access to planetary data that the astronomers on our homeworld could only dream of a mere generation ago.

To continue surveying;

£dot_green£ Select a £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§!
£dot_green£ Right-click a neighboring §SSystem§!
£dot_green£ Select §SSurvey System§!

A §SSystem§! must be surveyed before it can be claimed.

descriptions.zh:
研究新科技对我们成功至关重要。我这么说不仅是因为我自己就是科技的产物，更是因为我是你的可靠顾问，还有可能是你唯一真正的朋友。

我们应该最先研究§S新世界协议§!，这样就可以建造£colony_ship£§S殖民船§!，在其他£planet£§S行星§!上立足。
descriptions.en:
Researching new technologies will be critical to our success. I tell you this not merely as a product of unfettered technological progress, but as your trusted advisor and, I suspect, your only true friend.

One important technology that we should research as soon as possible is §SNew Worlds Protocol§!. It will give us access to £colony_ship£ §SColony Ships§! which will allow us to establish footholds on other £planet£ §SPlanets§!.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：科技研究§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Technology Research§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
欲拓其土，必先丈量之。而我们的£science_ship£§S科研船§!正是为此事而生。

你可以用如下图标识别出§S科研船§!：

                        £science_ship_map£


选择舰船的方式有两种；在§S星系地图§!或§S总览§!中点选。

£dot_green£选择一艘§S科研船§!
£dot_green£右键点击邻近£system£§S恒星系§!
£dot_green£选择§S调查恒星系§!

§S恒星系§!必须先完成调查之后才能宣称占领。
descriptions.en:
Before we can expand we must explore, and our £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§! are the vessel of choice for such a task.

You can identify a §SScience Ships§! by the following symbol:

                        £science_ship_map£


There are two ways of selecting a ship; From the §SGalaxy Map§! or the §SOutliner§!.

£dot_green£ Select a §SScience Ship§!
£dot_green£ Right-click a nearby £system£ §SSystem§!
£dot_green£ Select §SSurvey System§!

A §SSystem§! must be surveyed before it can be claimed.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：调查母星系§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Survey System§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
现在我们已经可以向我们的£science_ship£§S科研船§!下达出发的命令了。我们会需要取消§S星系地图§!模拟的暂停才能让一切继续。

§S取消暂停§!；

£dot_green£可以按§S空格键§!或是顶部栏的§S取消暂停§!按钮：

                    £pause_button£
descriptions.en:
Now that we have given a command to our £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§! it's time to set off. We will need to unpause the §SGalaxy Map§! simulation before anything can happen.

To §Sunpause§! the game;

£dot_green£ Press the §SSpace Bar§! or select the §SUnpause§! icon in the top bar

                    £pause_button£

tooltips.zh: §S教程：取消暂停§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Unpause§! added to Situation Log

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 非常好！刚刚研究完成的科技对我们作用很大。别忘了为£scientist£§S科学官§!们安排新的研究项目。
descriptions.en: Excellent work! The technology we just finished researching will certainly benefit us. Don't forget to give our £scientist£ §SScientists§! new research assignments.

descriptions.zh:
我们母星所能提供的资源也就只能支持我们走到这一步。我们的产业需要扩张到外星，这就需要有一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!。

如果我们收集到了足够的£alloys£§S合金§!，就赶紧[GetBuildGrow]一艘。
descriptions.en:
The resources generated by our homeworld will only take us so far. Our industry needs to expand off-world, and that requires a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!.

We should [GetBuildGrow] one as soon as we have amassed enough £alloys£ §SAlloys§! to do so.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：[GetBuildGrowCap]工程船§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: [GetBuildGrowCap] Construction Ship§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh: 非常好！£construction_ship£§S工程船§!可以运行了，上面的船员可都是帝国最棒的工程师。
descriptions.en: Good job! Our £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! is now up and running, and its hardy crew includes some of the finest engineers available to our nation.

descriptions.zh:
母星上生产的资源只够我们走到这一步，好在我们的£science_ship£§S科研船§!在另外一颗星球上发现了一处资源矿藏！

是时候派£construction_ship£§S工程船§![GetBuildGrow]一座£mining_station£§S开采站§!了。

§S开采站§!可以在帝国境内建造，它能自动采集所环绕天体上的£minerals£§S矿物§!、£energy£§S能量币§!以及£strategic_resource£§S战略资源§!。

选择§S工程船§!；

£dot_green£右键点击一个境内£system£§S恒星系§!
£dot_green£选择§S[GetBuildGrowCap]开采站§!

§S开采站§!需要花费§S能量币§!作为维护费。
descriptions.en:
The resources generated by our homeworld will only take us so far. Luckily our £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§! has just found a resource deposit on another world!

The time has come to use our £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! to [GetBuildGrow] a £mining_station£ §SMining Station§!.

§SMining Stations§! can be built within our borders and automatically collect £minerals£ §SMinerals§!, £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§!, and £strategic_resource£ §SStrategic Resources§!.

With the §SConstruction Ship§! selected;

£dot_green£ Right-click a claimed £system£ §SSystem§!
£dot_green£ Select §S[GetBuildGrowCap] Mining Stations§!

§SMining Stations§! have an §SEnergy Credit§! upkeep cost.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：[GetBuildGrowCap]开采站§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: [GetBuildGrowCap] Mining Station§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
非常好，新造好的£mining_station£§S开采站§!已经开始运行，采集将用于进一步处理的矿物了。

各种空间站的收入会直接加入帝国的总收入中，并显示在顶部栏里。将鼠标悬停在不同的资源图标上可以查看收支明细。
descriptions.en:
Very good. The new £mining_station£ §SMining Station§! is operational, and it has already begun gathering resources for processing.

Income from various stations is added to the empire's total income, which is displayed on the top bar. Hovering over different resources reveals a breakdown of income sources.

descriptions.zh:
调查过的星球有些会具有特殊性质，是非常好的研究项目。这些£physics£§S物理学§!，£society£§S社会学§!和£engineering£§S工程学§!资源可以用£science_ship£§S研究站§!采集。我的程序强烈建议我敦促你建造一个研究站。

记住§S研究站§!只能在帝国境内建造，它们需要£energy£ §S能量币§!来维持。
descriptions.en:
Surveyed worlds sometimes possess unique properties that make them valuable objects of research. These £physics£ §SPhysics§!, £society£ §SSociety§! or £engineering£ §SEngineering§! resources can be collected by a £science_ship£ §SResearch Station§!. My programming strongly compels me to compel you to build one.

Keep in mind that §SResearch Stations§! can only be built within our borders, and have a upkeep cost in £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§!.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：[GetBuildGrowCap]研究站§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: [GetBuildGrowCap] Research Station§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh: 我们的£science_ship£§S研究站§!已经上线，科学研究人员开始工作。这会解开什么谜团，揭示什么神秘事情呢？！
descriptions.en: Our new £science_ship£ §SResearch Station§! is online, and its science staff have begun their work. What secrets will they uncover, what forbidden mysteries of Creation?!

descriptions.zh:
宜居£planet£§S星球§!划分了若干£district£§S区划§!，§S特区§!以及£building£§S建筑§!。

£dot_green£§S区划§!可以由多个§S特区§!构成
£dot_green£§S特区§!决定产生的£job£§S岗位§!类型
£dot_green£§S建筑§!对§S特区§!提供增益

随着特区的升级将解锁越来越多的§S建筑§!槽。

有两种方式查看行星：
从§S星系地图§!或是§S总览§!

£dot_green£选择一颗§S行星§!
£dot_green£点击各个选项卡
descriptions.en:
Habitable £planet£ §SPlanets§! are divided into £district£ §SDistricts§!, §SZones§!, and £building£ §SBuildings§!.

£dot_green£§SDistricts§! can consist of multiple §SZones§!
£dot_green£§SZones§! determine which £job£ §SJobs§! are created
£dot_green£§SBuildings§! grant bonuses to the §SZones§!

More §SBuilding§! slots are unlocked as the zones are upgraded.

There are two ways of viewing a planet;
From the §SGalaxy Map§! or the §SOutliner§!.

£dot_green£ Select a §SPlanet§!
£dot_green£ Click on the different tabs

tooltips.zh: §S教程：殖民地建筑§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Colony Buildings§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
非常好，新的§S殖民地建筑§!已经建好，应该可以开始生产资源了。

随着£pops£§S人口§!的增长，他们会被自动指派到£building£§S建筑§!所产生的£job£§S岗位§!上，当然也可能会在不同岗位间切换。

优先一座§S建筑§!；

£dot_green£在§S总览§!选择£planet£§S行星§!
£dot_green£点击§S经济§!选项卡
£dot_green£点击一座§S建筑§!
descriptions.en:
Excellent. Construction has been finished on our new §SColony Building§!, and it should now begin producing resources.

£pops£ §SPops§! will automatically be assigned to any £job£ §SJobs§! created by £building£ §SBuildings§! as the population grows, but can also be encouraged to switch jobs.

To prioritize a §SBuilding§!;

£dot_green£ Select the £planet£ §SPlanet§! in the §SOutliner§!
£dot_green£ Click the §SEconomy§! tab
£dot_green£ Click on a §SBuilding§!

descriptions.zh:
宜居£planet£§S星球§!上有时会有£blocker£§S障碍§!，妨碍开发利用。清理§S障碍特征§!需要花费时间和£energy£§S能量币§!，但可能会解锁被其暂时阻碍的§S行星特征§!，还可以腾出新的建设空间。

清理§S障碍§!；

£dot_green£在§S总览§!中选择一颗行星
£dot_green£点击§S管理§!选项卡
£dot_green£在障碍上点击§S清理障碍§!按钮


                        £clear_blocker£


除了资源以外，一些§S障碍§!还需要额外的§S科技§!来移除。
descriptions.en:
Habitable £planet£ §SPlanets§! sometimes have £blocker£ §SBlockers§!, preventing their full exploitation. Clearing a §SBlocker§! takes time and costs £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§!, but can unlock §SPlanetary Features§! currently blocked as well as free up additional construction space.

To clear a §SBlocker§!;

£dot_green£ Select a planet in the §SOutliner§!
£dot_green£ Click the §SManagement§! tab
£dot_green£ Click the §SClear Blocker§! button on the blocker itself


                        £clear_blocker£


In addition to resources, some §SBlockers§! require specific §STechnologies§! to remove.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：障碍特征§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Feature Blockers§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
真不错！

£blocker£§S障碍§!成功清除了。

现在可以将鼠标悬停在任何§S障碍§!上，看看清理后都会解锁什么§S行星特征§!。

只要收集到足够的资源就应该把剩余的§S障碍§!也清理掉，让这颗£planet£§S行星§!得以发挥全部潜力。
descriptions.en:
Well done!

The £blocker£ §SBlocker§! has been successfully removed.

You can hover over any remaining §SBlockers§! to see which §SPlanetary Feature§! will be unlocked once they are cleared.

Any remaining §SBlockers§! should be cleared once enough resources have been gathered, to allow this £planet£ §SPlanet§! to reach its full potential.

descriptions.zh: 我们应该继续进行探索。我推荐派一艘£science_ship£§S科研船§!去调查周围的£system£§S星系§!。让我们勇敢地航向前人所未至的领域吧！
descriptions.en: We should continue our exploration efforts. I recommend sending a £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§! to survey neighboring £system£ §SStar Systems§!. Let us boldly go where no synthetic intelligence has gone before!

tooltips.zh: §S教程：调查星系§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Survey Systems§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
非常好！邻近我们£system£§S母星系§!的的星系已经都调查完毕了。接下来就该派£construction_ship£§S工程船§!去[GetBuildingGrowing]£mining_station£§S开采站§!和£science_ship£§S研究站§!来获得我们发现的那些资源了。

你可以用以下符号辨认出哪艘是§S工程船§!：

                        £construction_ship_map£
descriptions.en:
Great work! The stars neighboring our £system£ §SHome System§! have been fully explored. We should use our £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! to collect any resources that were found by [GetBuildingGrowing] £mining_station£ §SMining§! and £science_ship£ §SResearch Stations§!.

You can identify a §SConstruction Ship§! by the following symbol:

                        £construction_ship_map£

descriptions.zh:
我们应该考虑[GetBuildingGrowing]第二艘£science_ship£§S科研船§!了。这可以人我们加快对星系近邻的调查速度。

[GetBuildGrow]§S舰船§!；

£dot_green£选择一座§S恒星基地§!
£dot_green£点击§S船坞§!选项卡
£dot_green£点击§S科研船§!

新造§S舰船§!在建造完毕后会出现在§S恒星基地§!旁边。
descriptions.en:
We may want to consider [GetBuildingGrowing] a second £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§!. This would double the speed at which we can survey our galactic neighborhood!

To [GetBuildGrow] a §SShip§!;

£dot_green£ Select a §SStarbase§!
£dot_green£ Click on the §SShipyard§! tab
£dot_green£ Click on §SScience Ship§!

The newly constructed §SShip§! will appear next to the §SStarbase§! once completed.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：[GetBuildGrowCap]第二艘科研船§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: [GetBuildGrowCap] Second Science Ship§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
双倍£science_ship£§S科研船§!就会有双倍的乐趣！自从完成上个任务后，我还没那么兴奋过呢！

操作多艘科研船探索费时费力。

你可以通过选择§S科研船§!并在舰队交互界面点击§S科研船自动调查§!按钮自动化调查操作。


                        £science_ship_automate_exploration£
descriptions.en:
Double the £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§! means double the fun! Oh, I haven't been this excited since we completed the last assignment!

Exploring with multiple ships can be time-consuming.

You can automate surveying by selecting the §SScience Ship§! and clicking the §SScience Ship Automation§! button in the fleet interface.


                        £science_ship_automate_exploration£

descriptions.zh:
我们建造了新的£science_ship£§S科研船§!，但是没有指派操控飞船的£scientist£§S科学官§!！我的程序要求我指出雇佣一名新的§S科学家§!的好处。

选中§S科研船§!；

£dot_green£在舰队界面点击空白头像框
£dot_green£选择一位§S科学官；科学家§!

如果无法承担雇佣一名新§S科学家§!的费用，也可以从其他部门调用一名，虽然不怎么理想就是了。
descriptions.en:
We have a brand new £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§!, but no £scientist£ §SScientist§! has been assigned to command it. My programming insists that I should point out the benefits of adding an organic §SScientist§! component to the mix.

With the §SScience Ship§! selected;

£dot_green£ Click the empty portrait in the fleet interface
£dot_green£ Choose a §SScientist§!

If we cannot afford to recruit a new §SScientist§! we can always reassign one from another department, even though it is hardly ideal.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：招募科学官§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Recruit Scientist§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
好极了。£scientist£§S科学官§!已经安排到新的£science_ship£§S科研船§!上了，我们可以在闲时派遣他们出去探索新的£system£§S恒星系§!或者捅出些篓子了。

如果想更换§S科学官§!，只需要在舰队界面再次点击头像框即可。
descriptions.en:
Good. The £scientist£ §SScientist§! has assumed command of our new £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§!, and can now be sent off at our leisure to explore new £system£ §SSystems§! and/or meet some grisly fate.

Should you wish to change the §SScientist§!, then simply select the portrait once more in the fleet interface.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经准备好到下一个星球上延续和发展我们伟大的文明了，这时候就需要我们建造一艘£colony_ship£§S殖民船§!。

[GetBuildGrow]§S舰船§!；

£dot_green£选中一个§S恒星基地§!
£dot_green£点击§S船坞§!选项卡
£dot_green£点击§S殖民船舰船§!

新建成的§S舰船§!在建造完毕后会出现在§S恒星基地§!旁边。
descriptions.en:
We should now be ready to extend our great civilization to a second world. This will require the construction of a £colony_ship£ §SColony Ship§!.

To [GetBuildGrow] a §SShip§!;

£dot_green£ Select a §SStarbase§!
£dot_green£ Click on the §SShipyard§! tab
£dot_green£ Click on §SColony Ship§!

The newly constructed §SShip§! will appear next to the §SStarbase§! once completed.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：[GetBuildGrowCap]殖民船§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: [GetBuildGrowCap] Colony Ship§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
殖民者已经全部登上新建的£colony_ship£§S殖民船§!，舰长表示随时可以出发。真是一个值得纪念的日子！

建立£colony£§S殖民地§!有几种不同的方法。

在§S星系地图§!上§S殖民§!£planet£§S行星§!；

£dot_green£点击一颗可殖民§S行星§!
£dot_green£点击§S殖民§!按钮

                            £colonizable£

殖民者们出发之后，要花费数年时间来建立殖民地。
descriptions.en:
The colonists have all been transferred to the new £colony_ship£ §SColony Ship§!, and her captain reports all systems go. A momentous day, for sure!

There are different ways to establish a £colony£ §SColony§!.

To §SColonize§! a £planet£ §SPlanet§! on the §SGalaxy Map§!;

£dot_green£ Click a colonizable §SPlanet§!
£dot_green£ Click on the §SColonize§! button

                            £colonizable£

Once the colonists have disembarked, they will take a few years to fully establish the colony.

descriptions.zh: 我们拥有了一艘£colony_ship£§S殖民船§!，也发现了至少一处可以建造永久系外据点的星球。没理由犹豫了，快建立我们的第一个£colony£§S殖民地§!吧！
descriptions.en: We have a £colony_ship£ §SColony Ship§!, and we have found at least one suitable candidate for a permanent extrasolar outpost. I see no reason to delay further - let's establish our first £colony£ §SColony§!!

tooltips.zh: §S教程：建立殖民地§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Establish Colony§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh: 这是我们的第一个系外£colony£§S殖民地§!！这样就算母星发生爆炸，也不用担心面临消灭的命运了！还不赖吧？
descriptions.en: Our first extrasolar £colony£ §SColony§!! This means that if our homeworld were to spontaneously combust, your species would no longer be rendered extinct. That is a comforting thought, wouldn't you say?

descriptions.zh:
稳定的£minerals£§S矿物§!、£alloys£§S合金§!与£energy£§S能量币§!供应是任何星际势力繁荣发展的关键。我们应当采取措施增加这些资源的产量。

空间站和£building£§S建筑§!需要消耗合金或矿物来建造，还需要能量币来维护。§S舰船§!也是如此，只不过它们也需要合金来维护。这些资源由£mining_station£§S开采站§!或§S殖民地建筑§!生产。

后期你会发现一些有趣的新资源，可用于神秘的新建造。
descriptions.en:
A healthy supply of £minerals£ §SMinerals§!, £alloys£ §SAlloys§! and £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§! is critical to the well-being of any interstellar power. We should take steps to increase our production of these resources.

Stations and £building£ §SBuildings§! cost Alloys or Minerals to build and Energy Credits to maintain. The same is true for §SShips§!, except that they have an Alloy upkeep cost as well. These resources are produced by £mining_station£ §SMining Stations§! or §SColony Buildings§!. 

Later you may discover new and interesting resources to spend on esoteric new production.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：资源生产§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Resource Production§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh: 干得漂亮。这下我们有足够的资源去继续建设我们的宏伟帝国了。
descriptions.en: Excellent work. We now have a strong resource base to build our empire on.

descriptions.zh: 我们的舰队有点弱不禁风。在宇宙中有各种各样的危险，需要我们用武力手段进行回应。要记住，我们的文明时刻处于危险之中！
descriptions.en: I can't help but notice that our navy is a bit on the weak side. We are certain to face many threats in the galaxy that will require some form of military response. Remember, the survival of our civilization is at stake!

tooltips.zh: §S教程：扩展舰队§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Increase the Fleet§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh: 棒极了！我们的舰队小而精悍，应该能在突发的敌对遭遇中拥有上佳的表现。
descriptions.en: Good! We now have a small but capable space fleet that should serve us well in the event of any unexpected hostile encounters.

descriptions.zh:
我们的帝国蓬勃发展，规模已经大到我们没法通过母星直接进行控制了。我们应该建立新的§S星域§!。

星域是属于我们帝国的区域，能设为自主管理模式，居民可以在他们的权限范围内自行负责£planet£§S行星§!上的日常事务。
descriptions.en:
Our burgeoning empire has now reached a size where it is becoming difficult to administer directly from our homeworld. We should establish a new §SSector§!.

Sectors are areas within our empire that can be set to independently manage the day-to-day affairs of the £planet£ §SPlanets§! under their jurisdiction.

descriptions.zh: 随着帝国的发展，新的£colony£§S殖民地§!可以被划归进§S星域§!。星域可以在§S星球与星域§!界面进行自动管理，自动对£district£§S区划§!与£building£§S建筑§!进行建造与升级。
descriptions.en: As our empire grows, new £colony£ §SColonies§! can be organized into §SSectors§!. Sectors can be automated from the §SPlanets and Sectors§! screen to automatically build and upgrade £district£ §SDistricts§! and £building£ §SBuildings§! using assigned pools of resources.

descriptions.zh: 你可以指派§S总督§!管理整个§S星域§!。星域内的所有£planet£§S星球§!都将从总督的技能中受益。我们应当为我们的新星域指派一位总督。
descriptions.en: §SGovernors§! can be assigned to administrate entire §SSectors§!. All £planet£ §SPlanets§! within the sector will then benefit from the Governor's skills. We should assign one to our new sector.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：总督§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Sector Governor§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh: 我们的新§S总督§!已经在新星域的首府开始办公了。干的好。
descriptions.en: Our new §SSector Governor§! has assumed office on the sector's capital world. Well done.

descriptions.zh:
我们现在可以在§S舰船设计器§!界面中亲手设计新的§S舰船§!了。这个过程比较直截了当，当然我们也可以进行全自动设计。

访问§S舰船设计§!；

£dot_green£在左侧边栏点击§S舰队管理§!按钮或按§SF9§!键

                        £fleet_management£
descriptions.en:
We have the ability to manually design new §SShips§! in the §SShip Designer§! screen. This is a fairly straight-forward process, though one that can be fully automated if we so wish.

To access the §SShip Designer§!;

£dot_green£Click the §SFleet Management§! button on the left side bar or press §SF9§!

                        £fleet_management£

tooltips.zh: §S教程：舰船设计§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Ship Design§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
干的好。新的舰船设计已经添加到我们的数据库中，可以在装有§S船坞§!的§S太空港§!中进行生产。

新设计可以在任何时候在§S舰船设计器§!中进行编辑。设计做出变动时，已建造的§S舰船§!会需要在§S恒星基地§!中进行升级。

升级§S舰船§!；

£dot_green£在§S总览§!中选择§S舰船§!
£dot_green£在舰队界面点击§S升级§!按钮

                        £upgrade_ship£
descriptions.en:
Good job. The ship design has been added to our database, and can now be produced by a §SStarbase§! that has been equipped with a §SShipyard§!.

The new design can be edited at any time by revisiting the §SShip Designer§!. If any changes are made to the design, then §SShips§! already built will need to be upgraded at a §SStarbase§!.

To upgrade a §SShip§!;

£dot_green£ Select the §SShip§! in the §SOutliner§!
£dot_green£ Click the §SUpgrade§! button in the fleet interface

                        £upgrade_ship£

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]上发现了一片自然构造，其完美的几何结构令人窒息。这实乃上天的鬼斧神工，要引领我们到群星中去！

我们应该§Y继续调查§!这些异常现象。这样一定会获得新的知识和科技的吧。
descriptions.en:
We found a natural formation on [From.GetName], stunning in its geometrical perfection. This is surely a divine sign, marking our way out towards the stars!

We should §Ycontinue to investigate§! these sorts of anomalies whenever we get the chance. It will most assuredly grant us new knowledge and technology.

descriptions.zh:
经过研究，[From.GetName]上的异常现象是一种自然的§Y几何构造§!。看起来就像是一个指路的标记符号，宇宙的自然之美真是令人惊讶。

我们应该§Y继续调查§!这些异常现象。这样一定会获得新的知识和科技的吧。
descriptions.en:
The anomaly on [From.GetName] turned out to be a natural §Ygeometrical formation§!. It almost looks like a marker, showing the way forward. The natural beauty of the universe can be quite astonishing.

We should §Ycontinue to investigate§! these sorts of anomalies whenever we get the chance. It will most assuredly grant us new knowledge and technology.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]附近发现了微弱的超光速航道轨迹。其年代久远，业已无法进行追溯。这说明在很早之前就有星际旅行者来过这里，观察我们，收集情报。

我们应该§Y继续调查§!这些异常现象。这样一定会获得新的知识和科技的吧。
descriptions.en:
We have detected a weak FTL trail near [From.GetName]. It is very old, making it impossible to track. This must mean that other interstellar travelers have been here before, watching us, surely gathering intel.

We should §Ycontinue to investigate§! these sorts of anomalies whenever we get the chance. It will most assuredly grant us new knowledge and technology.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]上的异常现象显示了其他星际旅行者的痕迹！这些微弱的超光速航道轨迹表明，在很早之前，有人造访了我们£planet£§S行星§!寻求潜在的盟友。但是痕迹衰退严重，已无法进行追溯。

我们应该§Y继续调查§!这些异常现象。这样一定会获得新的知识和科技的吧。
descriptions.en:
The anomaly on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] shows traces of other interstellar travelers! A weak FTL trail shows that someone was here long ago, maybe watching our £planet£ §SPlanet§! for potential allies. It is too diminished to trace any further.

We should §Ycontinue to investigate§! these sorts of anomalies whenever we get the chance. It will most assuredly grant us new knowledge and technology.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]上的异常现象显示了其他星际旅行者的痕迹！这些微弱的超光速航道轨迹表明，在很早之前，有人造访了我们£planet£§S行星§!寻求潜在的盟友。但是痕迹衰退严重，已无法进行追溯。

We should §Ycontinue to investigate§! these sorts of anomalies whenever we get the chance. It will most assuredly grant us new knowledge and technology.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]探测到的异常现象背后，发现一些十分惊人的东西。[From.GetPlanetMoon]周围环绕着的轨迹显然是超光速引擎留下的。由于其年代久远，我们无法进行追溯。

我们应该§Y继续调查§!这些异常现象。这样一定会获得新的知识和科技的吧。
descriptions.en:
The anomaly we detected on [From.GetName] unveils something astonishing. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is surrounded by a trail undoubtedly produced by FTL engines. We are unable to trace it to its origin, due to it being generated long ago.

We should §Ycontinue to investigate§! these sorts of anomalies whenever we get the chance. It will most assuredly grant us new knowledge and technology.

label.zh: 我们曾经被人观察？对方究竟有何目的？
我们必须警惕异种的威胁。
label.en: We must beware the xeno threat.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]上找到了一个我方的§Y旧探测器§!。这些年来它一直保持运作，还试图将数据传送到母星上去。这是我们往日艰苦奋斗的纪念碑，也代表了昔日我们冲破§S行星§!枷锁的愿望。

我们应该§Y继续调查§!这些异常现象。这样一定会获得新的知识和科技的吧。
descriptions.en:
We found one of our §Yold probes§! on [From.GetName]. It has somehow kept intact all these years and is still trying to send data to our homeworld. It stands as a testament to our past struggles, and our wish to flee our §SPlanet's§! bounds.

We should §Ycontinue to investigate§! these sorts of anomalies whenever we get the chance. It will most assuredly grant us new knowledge and technology.

label.en: The divine surely has more in store.

label.zh: 我们的努力终于有了回报。
label.en: Our efforts have finally paid off.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一种§S战略资源§!！许多£strategic_resource£§S战略资源§!需要特定的科技才能利用，但可以从中获得强力的加成。

收集§S战略资源§!；

£dot_green£选中一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!
£dot_green£右键点击包含该资源的£system£§S恒星系§!
£dot_green£点击§S[GetBuildGrowCap]£mining_station£开采站§!

§S战略资源§!可以用于建造高级£building£§S建筑§!和舰船部件，也可以用来售卖。
descriptions.en:
We have uncovered a §SStrategic Resource§!! Many £strategic_resource£ §SStrategic Resources§! require specific technologies to exploit, but can confer powerful bonuses.

To secure a §SStrategic Resource§!;

£dot_green£ Select a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!
£dot_green£ Right-click the £system£ §SSystem§! containing the resource
£dot_green£ Select §S[GetBuildGrowCap] £mining_station£ Mining Stations§!

§SStrategic Resources§! can be used to build advanced £building£ §SBuildings§! and Ship components or simply sold.

descriptions.zh: 干的好。这些资源会让我们帝国更加富裕的！
descriptions.en: Excellent work. This resource is sure to greatly enrich our nation.

descriptions.zh:
我们现有的£mining_station£§S开采站§!在使用了新研发的科技之后就可以采集§S战略资源§!了。这些稀有资源会带来巨大的加成，同时也是极好的商品。真是一箭双雕啊！

更多的信息可以在§S情报日志§!里找到。星系里还有更多的£strategic_resource£§S战略资源§!等待我们去发现。继续探索吧！
descriptions.en:
Using recently-developed technology, an already-extant £mining_station£ §SMining Station§! can now mine a §SStrategic Resource§!. These rare resources confer powerful bonuses and make for valuable trade goods. Two metaphorical avians, allegorically struck down by an imaginary projectile.

More information can be found in the §SSituation Log§! for a time. There are many more £strategic_resource£ §SStrategic Resources§! left to discover in the galaxy, so keep on researching!

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了高度进化的动物生命！在正确§S科技§!的引领下，我们或许可以最终进行§H提升§!这些生命体的智慧和智力——或者说，是有机体中被认为是智力的东西。

哦。

§S基因表达学机制§!技术应该符合要求，我们是时候将这些生物提升到一个全新的境界了。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered highly-evolved animal life! With the right §STechnology§!, we may eventually be able to §HUplift§! these beings to sapience and intelligence - or what passes for intelligence among organics.

Oh.

The §SEpigenetic Triggers§! technology should fit the bill, and we are in fact ready to elevate these creatures into a brave new world of existential angst.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了高度进化的生命体！在正确§S科技§!的引领下，搞不好还可以进行§S提升§!，提升他们的自我知觉和智力——或者说，是有机体中被认为是智力的东西。

时刻注意我们的研究才是明智之选。如果有机会的话，我们可以将这个种群向§S外源性刺激§!推进。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered highly-evolved animal life! With the right §STechnology§!, we may eventually be able to §SUplift§! these beings to sapience and intelligence - or what passes for intelligence among organics.

It would perhaps be wise to keep an eye on our research, and direct it towards §SEpigenetic Triggers§! if given the opportunity.

descriptions.zh: 真是大获成功！那些原始的野兽已经提升到不那么原始的级别，成为我们蓬勃发展的帝国的人口了！
descriptions.en: A rousing success! The lowly beasts have been uplifted to become less lowly beasts, and are now proud citizens of our burgeoning empire.

descriptions.zh:
请注意！我们已经发现了拥有太空飞行能力的§S外星生物§!，他们是否具有智能尚不明确。不过，应该是有智能才对吧。我们必须完成§S调查§!才能揭开他们的神秘面纱。我建议我们先行行动，不要等到他们来调查我们……

要调查§S第一次接触§!；

£dot_green£打开§S情报日志§!
£dot_green£选择§S显示第一次接触§!

                            £firstcontact£

§S第一次接触§!也可通过点击§S星系地图§!上的图标发起
descriptions.en:
Remarkable! We have discovered §Sspacefaring alien entities§! that may or may not be intelligent, but, let's face it, probably are. Their true nature will remain a mystery to us until we complete the appropriate project to §SInvestigate§! them. I suggest we do so post-haste, lest they investigate us first...

To investigate a §SFirst Contact§!;

£dot_green£ Open the §SSituation Log§!
£dot_green£ Click on §SShow First Contact§!

                            £firstcontact£

§SFirst Contact§! can also be initiated by clicking the icon on the §SGalaxy map§!

tooltips.zh: §S教程：第一次接触§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: First Contact§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
我们建立沟通的尝试代表了我们技术上的成熟，但结果并不理想。§S如果宇宙中还有其他智能生物的话§!，也许是些只具备动物水平智能的家伙吧。

§S前智慧生物§!跟可没法搞什么外交，但取决于你的帝国类型，有时候可以对他们提升、灭绝、奴役或者进行观察。
descriptions.en:
Our attempts to establish communications stand testament to our technological ingenuity, but results are lacking. It is likely that the other party possesses only an animal level of intelligence, §Sif any at all§!.

§SPre-Sapients§! offer little to no diplomatic interactions, but depending on your empire type, they can sometimes be uplifted, exterminated, enslaved, or observed.

descriptions.zh:
看起来§S对方§!抢了我们的风头，在我们尚未解密他们的通讯模式前和我们§S建立了接触§!。

在下次有这样的机会出现时，希望可以由我们来完成这一步吧。
descriptions.en:
It appears the §Sother party§! completely stole our thunder, §Sestablishing contact§! with us before we had managed to decipher their communications protocols.

We should still attempt to accomplish this feat for ourselves, when the opportunity next presents itself.

descriptions.zh:
多亏了近来遗传学的进步，我们已经获得了额外的§S特质点数§!，可以用来§S修饰§!和强化我们的人民了。

修饰§S物种§!；

£dot_green£打开§S物种§!选项卡或按§SF6§!键
£dot_green£点击§S修饰§!按钮
£dot_green£研究§S特殊项目§!
descriptions.en:
Thanks to recent advances in genetics, we have gained an extra §STrait Point§! that we can use to §SModify§! and enhance our people.

To modify a §SSpecies§!;

£dot_green£ Select the §SSpecies§! tab or press §SF6§!
£dot_green£ Click on the §SModify§! button
£dot_green£ Research §SSpecial Project§!

tooltips.en: §STutorial: Modify Species§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh: 真是太棒了。我们的帝国终于摆脱了自然进化的束缚，一定可以在宇宙中大展宏图了。
descriptions.en: Commendable. With the yoke of natural evolution lifted from their shoulders, our people are sure to thrive in space.

descriptions.zh:
为了缩短£system£§S恒星系§!间的遥远距离，我们的£scientist£§S科学家§!们发明了§S超空间引擎§!。这种装置可以在超空间连接的两个恒星系间以远超光速的速度穿梭。

虽然使用超空间进行移动速度极快，但这种旅行只能限制在星系超维平面网络上。

要进入超空间，§S舰船§!必须先抵达恒星系边缘，到恒星重力井之外。

当指挥§S舰船§!移动到其他§S恒星系§!时会自动进行。
descriptions.en:
To overcome the vast distances that separate £system£ §SStar Systems§!, our £scientist£ §SScientists§! have developed the §SHyper Drive§!. This device permits travel at speeds far exceeding that of light between systems connected by hyperlanes.

Travel along a hyperlane is nearly instantaneous, but movement is restricted to the galactic hyperlane network. 

To enter hyperspace, a §SShip§! must first reach the system's edge, beyond the star's gravity well.

This happens automatically when ordering a §SShip§! to move to another §SSystem§!.

descriptions.zh:
只要有合适的技术，我们就有将低级生物§Y提升§!至开智种族的方法了。

要提升§S物种§!；

£dot_green£打开§S未开智§!£planet£§S行星§!
£dot_green£选择§S管理§!选项卡
£dot_green£选中§S物种§!
£dot_green£点击§S设置权利§!
£dot_green£点击§S提升§!
descriptions.en:
Having researched the appropriate technology, we now have the means to §YUplift§! lesser beings to sapience.

To uplift a §SSpecies§!;

£dot_green£ Open the §SPre-Sapient§! £planet£ §SPlanet§!
£dot_green£ Click the §SManagement§! tab
£dot_green£ Select the §SSpecies§!
£dot_green£ Click on §SSet Rights§!
£dot_green£ Click on §SUplift§!

The species will begin the uplift process, gaining full sapience once completed.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经开始探索邻近的一些星系，或许是时候再将手伸远一些了。

§S恒星基地§!可以在已调查的£system£§S恒星系§!中建造，用以拓展疆界，为我们获取新空间区域的所有权。

有了更先进的科技后，恒星基地还可以升级并用于产出§S舰船§!或者资源。

宣称§S恒星系§!；

£dot_green£选择一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!
£dot_green£右键点击一个已调查的§S恒星系§!
£dot_green£选择§S[GetBuildGrowCap]恒星基地§!
descriptions.en:
Now that we have begun exploring our neighboring stars, it might be time to extend our reach.

A §SStarbase§! can be built around stars in surveyed £system£ §SSystems§! to expand our borders, allowing us to claim new regions of space

With future technologies, Starbases can be upgraded to produce §SShips§! or other resources.

To claim a §SSystem§!;

£dot_green£ Select a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!
£dot_green£ Right-click a surveyed §SSystem§!
£dot_green£ Select §S[GetBuildGrowCap] Starbase§!

tooltips.zh: §S教程：恒星基地§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Starbases§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
很棒。你在§S星系地图§!中就能看到，我们帝国的疆界已经拓展到了这个刚刚建好§S恒星基地§!的£system£§S恒星系§!上了。

新建的§S恒星基地§!只是一座哨站，只有非常有限的防御能力，没有安装§S模组§!和£building£§S建筑§!的空间。因此，这些没有升级过的哨站是不会显示在总览中的。

升级§S恒星基地§!；

£dot_green£在§S星系地图§!点击恒星系
£dot_green£选中§S恒星基地§!
£dot_green£点击§S升级§!按钮
descriptions.en:
Excellent. As you can see on the §SGalaxy Map§!, the borders of our empire have expanded to include the £system£ §SSystem§! where we built our new §SStarbase§!.

A newly built §SStarbase§! acts as an Outpost, with limited defensive capabilities and no room for §SModules§! and £building£ §SBuildings§!. As such, it does not yet appear in the outliner until it has been upgraded.

To upgrade a §SStarbase§!;

£dot_green£ Click the system on the §SGalaxy Map§!
£dot_green£ Select the §SStarbase§!
£dot_green£ Click on the §SUpgrade§! button

descriptions.zh: §H教程§!与§H提示§!已关闭。
descriptions.en: §HTutorial Missions§! and §HTips§! are disabled.

descriptions.zh: §H提示§!启用，§H教程§!关闭。
descriptions.en: §HTips§! are enabled, §HTutorial Missions§! are disabled.

descriptions.zh: §H教程§!与§H提示§!均开启。
descriptions.en: §HTutorial Missions§! and §HTips§! are enabled.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一些£minor_artifacts£§S稀有文物§!。稀有文物是一种深奥的资源，是一个用于描述我们不了解的、事实上可能无法解释的奇怪事物的笼统术语。

它们可以用于执行各种不同的决议。

使用§S稀有文物§!；

£dot_green£在左侧边栏点击§S发现§!
£dot_green£选择§S收藏§!选项卡或按§SC§!键

                        £discoveries£
descriptions.en:
We have discovered some £minor_artifacts£ §SMinor Artifacts§!. These are an esoteric resource - a catch-all term for strange items which we do not understand and indeed may be inexplicable.

These can be used to enact a variety of decisions.

To interact with §SMinor Artifacts§!;

£dot_green£ Click the §SDiscoveries§! button on the left side bar
£dot_green£ Select the §SCollection§! tab or press §SC§!

                        £discoveries£

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一些£astral_threads£§S星界丝缕§!它们是时空压缩的细丝，是维度位面碰撞的产物。通常情况下，这些丝线只能从§S星界细缝§!中获取，或者进入£astral_rift£§S星界裂隙§!中取回。

执行各种§S星界行动§!；

£dot_green£在左边栏点击§S发现§!按钮
£dot_green£选择§S星界丝缕§!选项卡

                        £discoveries£

你可以通过探索§S星界裂隙§!解锁更多的行动类型，这些裂隙可能从§S星界细缝§!或其他异常事件中出现。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered some £astral_threads£ §SAstral Threads§!. These are filaments of condensed space-time: the result of dimensional planes colliding. Typically, these can only be harvested from §SAstral Scars§! or recovered inside £astral_rift£ §SAstral Rifts§!.

To perform various §SAstral Actions§!;

£dot_green£ Click the §SDiscoveries§! button on the left side bar
£dot_green£ Select the §SAstral Threads§! tab

                        £discoveries£

You can unlock additional actions by exploring §SAstral Rifts§!, which can emerge from §SAstral Scars§! or form through other anomalous events.

descriptions.zh: 某些§S第一次接触§!会给出选项，让我方选择如何进行接触事项。这些选择也会长期地影响同其他帝国的外交关系。
descriptions.en: Some §SFirst Contact§! missions will present options for how we wish to conduct matters. These choices can affect our diplomatic relationships with other empires for a long time.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：第一次接触§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: First Contact§! added to Situation Log

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
通讯协议已经建立。我们现在可以同这个帝国展开§S外交§!。他们对我方的当前评价取决于我们在§S第一次接触§!时采取的行径。

要展开§S外交§!；

£dot_green£在左侧边栏点击§S通讯§!按钮或按§SF10§!键

                        £contacts£

在第一次接触任务中，我们也获取了一些情报。随着我们逐渐掌握一个帝国的情报，更多有关他们的细节也将为我们所见。
descriptions.en:
Communications protocols have been established. We can now engage in §SDiplomacy§! with this Empire. Their current opinion of us depends on how §SFirst Contact§! was conducted.

To engage in §SDiplomacy§!;

£dot_green£Click the §SContacts§! button on the left side bar or press §SF10§!

                        £contacts£

During first contact, we also gain Intel. As we gain further Intel on an empire, more details about them become visible to us.

descriptions.zh:
我们与一种不同类型的文明进行了§S第一次接触§!——这类文明通常不愿与其他国家开展§S外交§!。

能够与这类文明进行的外交行动十分有限，然而他们也有可能偶尔会决定主动接触我们。
descriptions.en:
We have made §SFirst Contact§! with a different type of civilization - one which is generally unwilling to engage in §SDiplomacy§! with others.

The diplomatic actions we can take with civilizations like this are limited, however they may decide to contact us from time to time.

descriptions.zh:
§S线人§!泛指有价值的特工和装置，能为我方谍报活动提供不同效果。线人在间谍网内发挥作用，也可以指派到行动当中，以发掘新的机会或是帮助我们摆脱困境。

我们可以通过事件或者执行§S招募线人§!行动来得到线人。
descriptions.en:
§SAssets§! are valuable agents and artifacts which provide different effects for our Espionage activities. They work within the Spy Network and may be assigned to Operations, where they can open up new opportunities or else help us out of trouble.

We may receive Assets through events, or by performing the §SAcquire Asset§! Operation.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经与一个§S太空城邦§!进行了§S第一次接触§!。太空城邦是一种小型但独立的国家，可以与像我们这样的大型帝国开展贸易，并且外交形式也较为独特。
descriptions.en: We have made §SFirst Contact§! with an §SEnclave§!. This is a smaller, independent type of empire which may trade with larger empires like ours, using unique forms of Diplomacy.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经与一个§S太空城邦§!进行了§S第一次接触§!。太空城邦是一种小型但独立的国家，可以与像我们这样的大型帝国开展贸易，并且外交形式也较为独特。

太空城邦能够提供多种形式的服务：从协助科学研究到倒卖信息，从修建恒星基地建筑到贩卖§S舰船§!，应有尽有。购买城邦的服务将提升他们对你的§S评价§!。
descriptions.en:
We have made §SFirst Contact§! with an §SEnclave§!. This is a smaller, independent type of empire which may trade with larger empires like ours, using unique forms of Diplomacy.

Enclaves offer a wide variety of services: from conducting scientific research to selling information, starbase buildings, and even §SShips§!. Purchasing services like these will increase that enclave's §SOpinion§! of us.

descriptions.zh: 我们接触到了一个§S佣兵城邦§!。这些独立自主的军事专家会向各种国家，当然也包括我们国家，收费并租借§S佣兵舰队§!
descriptions.en: We have encountered a §SMercenary Enclave§!. These independent military specialists may loan out §SMercenary Fleets§! to empires including our own - for a fee.

descriptions.zh:
我们接触到了一个§S佣兵城邦§!。这些独立自主的军事专家会向各种国家，当然也包括我们国家，收费并租借§S佣兵舰队§!

如果我们选择租借一支佣兵舰队，我们会在指定时间内获得舰队的控制权。在该时间段内，城邦会增补损失的舰船，但不论如何我们都无法将佣兵舰队极其海军司令与我方舰船合并。
descriptions.en:
We have encountered a §SMercenary Enclave§!. These independent military specialists may loan out §SMercenary Fleets§! to empires including our own - for a fee.

If we choose to hire a Mercenary Fleet, we will retain control of it for a set period of time. During that time, the Enclave will attempt to reinforce the fleet when necessary, however neither a Mercenary Fleet nor its Admiral may be integrated with our own fleets.

descriptions.zh: 如果我们同意，§Y[tutorial_mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!马上可以建立§S佣兵城邦§!，舰船也将不再受我们控制，重新成为独立性军事力量，并且可以重新向包括我们在内的所有国家租借§S佣兵舰队§!。
descriptions.en: §Y[tutorial_mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! is now capable of becoming a §SMercenary Enclave§!, if we so wish. The fleet would cease to be under our direct control - instead it would become an independent force, capable of loaning out §SMercenary Fleets§! to empires including our own.

descriptions.zh:
如果我们同意，§Y[tutorial_mercenary_fleet.GetName]§!马上可以建立§S佣兵城邦§!，舰船也将不再受我们控制，重新成为独立性军事力量，并且可以重新向包括我们在内的所有国家租借§S佣兵舰队§!。

如果我们划出一片区域给佣兵城邦，那么只要它们把佣兵舰队租借给其他国家，我们就可以赚取§S收入§!。如果我们选择自己租借舰队，我们将在一定时间内保留对该舰队的控制权。另外如果雇佣舰队目前不可用，帝国需要额外支付一笔费用。
descriptions.en:
§Y[tutorial_mercenary_fleet.GetName]§! is now capable of becoming a §SMercenary Enclave§!, if we so wish. The fleet would cease to be under our direct control - instead it would become an independent force, capable of loaning out §SMercenary Fleets§! to empires including our own.

For as long as we share space with the Mercenary Enclave, we stand to earn §Sincome§! whenever it loans its Mercenary Fleet out to other empires. If we choose to hire the Mercenary Fleet ourselves, we will retain control of that fleet for a set period of time. Empires may pay extra to buy out an existing contract if the Mercenary Fleet is not currently available.

descriptions.zh:
£megastructure£§S巨型结构§!是一种我们可以在太空中[GetBuildGrow]的巨大工程。它们可以为我们提供顶尖的研究设施、海量的资源、甚至是一些独特的交通方式。

建立一个巨型结构需要投入大量的时间和资源，但回报也同样可观。我们可以通过派遣一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!来开始修建巨型结构。
descriptions.en:
£megastructure£ §SMegastructures§! are colossal projects that we can [GetBuildGrow] out in the void of space. They may provide us with cutting-edge research facilities, access to superior resources, or even some unique forms of transportation.

Building on such a scale requires a significant investment of time and resources, but the rewards are every bit as sizable. We can get under way by setting a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! to this task.

descriptions.zh: 得益于我们在巨型工程研究的进展，我们现在可以在宜居£planet£§S行星§!外围修建§S星环基地§!了。通过指派一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!以开始修建。
descriptions.en: Thanks to our recent advances in mega-engineering research, we are now able to construct §SOrbital Rings§! around habitable £planet£ §SPlanets§!. We can begin building by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!.

descriptions.zh:
§S星环基地§!是一种能够环抱整颗£planet£§S行星§!的£megastructure£§S巨型结构§!。它能搭建起一条支持空地间高效运转的通道，为诸如船坞、防御结构、资源仓库之类的的建筑提供空间。

在星环基地界面我们可以修建或者移除£building£§S建筑§!或是§S模块§!，也可以升级星环基地至更高等级。升级基地可以增加可用的槽位数量，不过等级上限受到殖民地基础设施的限制。
descriptions.en:
§SOrbital Rings§! are vast £megastructure£ §SMegastructures§! which are built to encircle an entire £planet£ §SPlanet§!. They make for an efficient bridge between space and the planet below, providing room for facilities like Shipyards, defensive structures, and resource hubs.

The Orbital Ring view is where we can add or remove £building£ §SBuildings§! and §SModules§!, as well as upgrade the Orbital Ring to higher tiers. Upgrading tiers increases the number of slots we have available to build in. Tiers are limited by colony infrastructure.

descriptions.zh: 得益于我们在巨型工程研究的进展，我们现在可以在§S脉冲星§!或§S中子星§!周围修建§S量子弹弓§!了。通过指派一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!以开始修建。
descriptions.en: Recent advances in mega-engineering research mean we may now construct a §SQuantum Catapult§! around a §Spulsar§! or §Sneutron star§!. We can begin building by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!.

descriptions.zh:
§S量子弹弓§!能弹射§S舰船§!与舰队跨越遥远的天文尺度距离。该项科技极大地增强了我们应对帝国内部或是周边区域的应对能力。

不过使用量子弹弓也有一定的风险，例如舰队有可能被弹射到预定目标以外的£system£§S恒星系§!。当然我们可以通过升级量子弹弓到更高等级，提高吞吐量与最大跃迁范围等属性，从而降低这些风险。
descriptions.en:
The §SQuantum Catapult§! launches §SShips§! and fleets across vast, interstellar distances. This technology greatly improves our ability to react to emerging situations within our empire, and in nearby regions of space.

Use of the Quantum Catapult carries some risk, as our fleets may arrive in £system£ §SSystems§! other than their intended target. We can mitigate these risks - and improve matters like throughput and maximum range - by upgrading the Quantum Catapult to higher tiers.

descriptions.zh: 鉴于在§S超空间中继器§!方面的巨型工程研究已经产出了一定成果，我们可以着手指派一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!开始修建一个中继器网络。
descriptions.en: Our mega-engineering research has yielded results in the form of §SHyper Relays§!. We can begin forming a network of these by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§!.

titles.zh: 教程：教程：超空间中继器

descriptions.zh:
§S超空间中继器§!能够加快在相邻£system£§S恒星系§!航行的速度。如果能够将§S至少两个§!超空间中继器链接到一起，那么我们就可以建立一个显著加快帝国内部航行速度的网络。

超空间中继器也能与开放边境的相邻国家内部的中继器链接，从而将两国的网络相连。这将提高§S舰船§!穿越相邻国家的速度。
descriptions.en:
§SHyper Relays§! allow for more efficient travel between adjacent £system£ §SStar Systems§!. By linking §Sat least two§! Hyper Relays together, we can begin to establish a network which will dramatically reduce transit times across our empire.

Hyper Relays may also be built adjacent to each other across open borders, linking whole networks together. This will allow §SShips§! to travel swiftly across neighboring empires.

descriptions.zh:
我们探测到了一个§S前超光速社会§!！虽然他们没有我们穿越星际的技术，但我们仍然可以从这些外星人身上得到很多东西。不论是学习他们的文化还是奴役他们，都取决于我们。

如果计划观察他们（假定他们在我们的掌控范围内），我们需要在他们星球轨道上建立一座§S观测站§!。

如果打算入侵他们，我们只需召集军队，他们没什么胜算。
descriptions.en:
We have detected a §SPre-FTL society§!! Although they lack the kind of technology that allows us to traverse the stars, there is still a lot to be gained from these aliens. Whether it be learning from their culture or claiming them as slaves is up to us.

If we wish to observe them - assuming they are within our borders - we need to build an §SObservation Post§! around their world.

If we wish to invade, all we need do is muster our troops; they wouldn't stand much of a chance.

tooltips.zh: §S教程：观测站§!已添加至情报日志
tooltips.en: §STutorial: Observation Posts§! added to Situation Log

descriptions.zh:
我们的新§S观测站§!上线了。只要我们研究目标的£awareness£§S觉醒度§!保持低位，它就会继续执行§S任务§!。

一旦前超光速社会的觉醒度达到上限，我们就无法再观察他们了。相反地，我们可以采取§S外交行动§!与他们接触。若§S干涉政策§!允许，我们也可提早现身。
descriptions.en:
Our new §SObservation Post§! has come online and will proceed with its §SMission§! as long as the £awareness£ §SAwareness§! of the object of our study stays low.

Once a Pre-FTL society reaches maximum awareness, they will no longer be observable. Instead, we will be able to engage them with §SDiplomatic Actions§!. We may choose to reveal ourselves early if our §SInterference Policies§! allow it.

descriptions.zh:
我们的新§S观测站§!上线了。只要我们研究目标的£awareness£§S觉醒度§!保持低位，它就会继续执行§S任务§!。

我们能持续地从观测站获得一条独特的科技树，即§S观测洞见§!，直到这个前超光速社会的觉醒度达到上限而导致任务终止时。

若是此类情况发生，我们可以取而代之采取§S外交行动§!与他们接触。若§S干涉政策§!允许，我们也可提早现身。
descriptions.en:
Our new §SObservation Post§! has come online and will proceed with its §SMission§! as long as the £awareness£ §SAwareness§! of the object of our study stays low.

We will gain §SObservation Insights§!, a unique line of technology, from this outpost until the Pre-FTL society reaches max awareness when missions will be disabled. Instead, we will be able to engage them with §SDiplomatic Actions§!.

We could choose to reveal ourselves early if our §SInterference Policies§! allow it.

descriptions.zh:
这个前超光速文明知晓了我们的存在。根据我们的§S政策§! 立场，我们目前能够采取有限的§S外交§!与§S行星§!的领袖接触。

我们的存在已在星球上公开，也就没有继续观测的必要了。我们的§S观测任务§!已终止。
descriptions.en:
The pre-FTL civilization knows of our existence. We can now engage in limited §SDiplomacy§! with the §SPlanet's§! leadership, depending on our §SPolicy§! stance.

With our presence made public to the planet, there is no longer anything to gain from observing the civilization. Our §SObservation Missions§! have been disabled.

descriptions.zh:
力场操纵研究领域的最新进展促使我们发明了§S隐形场发生器§!。这些功率密集型部件可以投射出改良的粒子场，使我们的科研和军事舰船能够规避普通的传感器。

然而，这些隐形场在激活时将对§S基础舰船速度§!、§S超空间跃迁充能时间§!和§S护盾承受值§!产生负面影响。

未被发现的§S隐形§!船只可以规避§S关闭边境§!导致的影响。
在§S隐形§!状态下，我们的£science_ship£§S科研船§!能够对他国的£colony£§S殖民地§!执行§S主动侦察§!，增加我们获得的关于其他帝国的情报。
descriptions.en:
Recent advances in Field Manipulation research have led to the invention of §SCloaking Field Generators§!. These power-intensive components project modified particle fields allowing our science and military vessels to hide from conventional sensors.

However, these cloaking fields will negatively affect §SBase Ship Speed§!, §SHyper Jump Charge Time§! and §SShield Hit Points§! while active.

§SCloaked§! ships that remain undetected can ignore §SClosed Borders§!.
While §SCloaked§!, our £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§! will be capable of conducting §SActive Reconnaissance§! on foreign £colony£ §SColonies§!, increasing the Intel we gain on other empires.

descriptions.zh:
计算机研究领域的最新进展促使我们发明了§S探测阵列§!。在我们的§S恒星基地§!上安装这些高功率的外部传感器，将使我们有能力探测到§S隐形§!舰队。

通过将多个阵列耦合在一起，我们可以提高§S探测阵列§!的灵敏度，使它们能够穿透越来越稳定的§S隐形力场§!。

随着进一步研究，我们应该能够利用£science_ship£§S科研船§!来进一步提高这些探测能力。这些设备的范围受限于恒星基地的§S探测范围§!。
descriptions.en:
Recent advances in Computing research have led to the invention of §SDetection Arrays§!. Installing these high-powered external sensors on our §SStarbases§! will grant the ability to detect §SCloaked§! fleets.

The sensitivity of the §SDetection Arrays§! can be increased by coupling multiple arrays together, allowing them to penetrate increasingly stable §SCloaking Fields§!.

With further research, we should be able to use £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§! to further increase boost these detection capabilities. The range of these devices is limited by the starbase's §SSensor Range§!.

descriptions.zh:
有灵能人口定居的殖民地能够散发§S灵能光环§!。光环来源于我们当前§S调和度§!最高的§S虚境超主§!。

灵能光环在为帝国提供多种多样的修正效果的同时，也能对友好或者敌对国家施加影响。我们如果想要扩大光环的范围，就需要通过与超主进一步调和来解锁£research£§S灵能光环增强§!科技。

打开§S虚境§!选项卡或者将鼠标悬停在正下方£interface£§S恒星系预览§!面板中的的光环图标上均可以查看灵能光环的效果。
descriptions.en:
Our colonies with psionic populations now have the ability to emit a §SPsionic Aura§!. This Aura is drawn from the §SShroud Patron§! with which we currently have the highest §SAttunement§!.

Psionic Auras have varying effects on our own empire, and can also affect friendly or hostile empires. To expand our Aura into more systems, we will need to more fully attune to a Patron in order to unlock £research£ §SPsionic Aura Intensification§! technology.

To observe the effects of our Psionic Aura, open the §SShroud§! tab or hover over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £interface£ §SSystem View§!.

descriptions.zh:
§S灵能光环§!能够提高§S强度§!并向外扩散到其他恒星系。

灵能光环有三个强度等级，分别产生不同的效果。灵能光环在提升强度等级或强度提升至最大值时，会试着向临近恒星系扩散。大多数灵能光环的扩散距离有上限。‘

有多种途径能够增强光环，例如繁衍更多灵能人口、提升£happiness£§S幸福度§!、增加£job_telepath£[GetTelepathCap]岗位数量，以及在£sector£星域中雇佣具有灵能能力的总督或者£leader£领袖。
descriptions.en:
Our §SPsionic Aura§! now has the ability to gain §SIntensity§! and spread into other systems.

Psionic Auras can reach three thresholds of Intensity, with scaling effects. If a Psionic Aura reaches a new level of Intensity, or maximizes its Intensity, it will attempt to spread to adjacent systems. Most Psionic Auras have a maximum range they can spread from their source.

Aura Intensity can be increased through various means, such as high Psionic populations, £happiness£ §SHappiness§! levels, £job_telepath£ [GetTelepathCap] Jobs, and Psychic Governors or £leader£ Leaders of £sector£ Sectors.

descriptions.zh:
§S灵能光环§!可能会与另一个扩散到相邻星系的光环发生冲突。一旦出现这种情况，这两个光环就会相互对抗，并决出最终由哪个光环来实控该恒星系。

对抗的结果取决于双方光环每月§S强度§!增长，可以将鼠标悬停在正下方£interface£§S恒星系预览§!面板中的光环图标来查看这一过程。
descriptions.en:
Our §SPsionic Aura§! has encountered another Aura in an adjacent connected system. When this occurs, the two Auras may compete to determine which will spread into the other system.

This process depends on the monthly §SIntensity§! gain of each opposing Aura, which can be observed by hovering over the Aura icon on the bottom-center panel in £interface£ §SSystem View§!.
